Petition: Prevent police action on free speech issues by better defining terms in UK Law.

This is in regards to Markus Meechan in Scotland, being arrested for posting a joke on Youtube.

I know this isn't specifically a MGTOW issue, but I've noticed most of us are pro free speech, so I figured it may be of interest.

In my opinion, you've still got too many exceptions there: "This piece of legislation should be rewrote to allow any speech to be permitted without fear of police involvement except in cases of incitements of violence, harrassment or targeted bullying, threats etc."

Every exception to freedom that you allow will inevitably be used against you. Someone is going to claim that disliking the ruling party is equivalent to an incitement to violence against them. SJWs already conflate words with physical violence. They already label simple disagreement as harassment.

Also, there are spelling and grammatical errors that make the petition seem less serious. But, those are just my opinions. Good luck to you! It's a worthy cause.
I agree, but unfortunately it isn't my petition. I just came across it on a subreddit, and thought it was worth posting around.
